# IM UI

IM UI maps host-provided conversation, message, composer, media, and call state into accessible cross-platform interfaces.

## Dependency

Foundation → General UI → IM UI → Product. IM UI may compose General UI but cannot depend on a Flare application.

## Models

Read [Message lifecycle](/en/im/message-lifecycle), [Message status](/en/im/message-status), and [Message content](/en/im/message-content), then browse Conversation, Message, Composer, Media, Contacts, Group, Call, Profile, and Moments.

## Workspaces

Conversation, chat, thread, search, and settings are composed as [Patterns](/en/patterns/) rather than duplicating business state inside one component.
